svg.aria-label: F156 the web's pacing switch: the interface design
svg.title: F156 the web's pacing switch: the interface design

g.text: F156 the web's pacing switch: the interface design
sets Stream-Paced: on when STREAM_PACE is on
hands the caption its turn's ServerPaced
calls it once when the header says on
paces only when streaming and not server paced

text.tspan: The API says on each turn's stream whether the engine paced it; the page reads it as the turn opens and leaves its own pacer off for that turn.
